summary: Hafnia Ltd, a Singapore-domiciled, Oslo- and NYSE-listed tanker operator, furnished a Form 6-K containing a press release dated October 12, 2026, disclosing a mandatory insider-trade notification under EU Market Abuse Regulation Article 19 and Norwegian Securities Trading Act section 5-12. CFO Perry (Petrus Wouter) Van Echtelt sold 50,000 shares on October 9, 2026 at an average NOK 101.5203 per share, aggregating NOK 5,076,015, on Oslo Børs. Following the disposal, he retains 563,544 shares and options. No board recommendation, advisor, deal terms, or special-situation mechanics are present; this is a routine PDMR disclosure.
